sentences.en: Foreign direct investments in China amounted to $3 billion last year.
sentences.zh: 去年中国吸引的外国直接投资达到30亿美元。

sentences.en: You disobeyed a direct order and must pay the consequences.
sentences.zh: 你违抗了直接命令，必须承担后果。

sentences.en: I stepped outside and was bathed in the harsh, direct sunlight.
sentences.zh: 我走到了外面，被强烈的阳光照射着。
